label: UPS module
source: M. Wiboonrat (2020), Condition-Based Maintenance for Data Center Operations Management, Table 2, E39-200; explicitly reproduces IEEE 493 data.
notes: Published rounded annual rate. Source equipment: small computer-room UPS. Applying to larger modular equipment is a modelling extrapolation.

label: Diesel generator
source: M. Wiboonrat (2020), Table 2, E18-121; IEEE 493 continuous-duty packaged diesel generator.
notes: Published rate 0.58/year used verbatim (source failure counts and exposure are internally inconsistent). Continuous-duty, 250 kW–1.5 MW class; extrapolation at larger sizes. Not a failure-to-start probability. Audit: 115 / 266 = 0.432330827 per year, versus printed 0.58; 8760 / 15033.8 = 0.582687. Neither alternative is independently validated. Compare both in sensitivity analysis.

label: Power distribution unit
source: User-supplied project README, section 6: midpoint of illustrative ranges. NOT verified IEEE 493 data.
notes: Demo assumption. Replace with equipment-specific, cited evidence before publishing research results. Source audit 2026-09-12: Wiboonrat Table 2 contains neither PDU nor CRAC rate entries; a switchgear rate is not a valid substitute.

label: Cooling unit (CRAC)
source: User-supplied project README, section 6: midpoint of illustrative ranges. NOT verified IEEE 493 data.

label: Automatic transfer switch
source: M. Wiboonrat (2020), Table 2, E34-110; IEEE 493 automatic transfer switch >600 A.
notes: Published rounded annual rate and mean repair duration. Ideal switching assumed; switching delay not modelled.
